mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EP.PRODUCT_NO, MAX(EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE) AS ACTIVE_EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP INNER JOIN EVENT E ON E.EVENT_NO = EP.EVENT_NO WHERE E.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(E.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(E.END_DATE) GROUP BY EP.PRODUCT_NO ) AED ON AED.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
mapper.select: SELECT CART_NO, MEMBER_NO, CREATED_AT FROM CART WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CART_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CART ( CART_NO, MEMBER_NO, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{cartNo}, #{memberNo}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL(AED.ACTIVE_EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0)) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.STOCK, 0) AS STOCK, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MAX(IMAGE_PATH) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, IMAGE_NO ) AS MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) PI ON PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CART_ITEM_NO, CART_NO, PRODUCT_NO, QUANTITY, CREATED_AT FROM CART_ITEM WHERE CART_NO = #{cartNo} AND PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY CART_ITEM_NO ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT CI.CART_ITEM_NO, CI.CART_NO, CI.PRODUCT_NO, CI.QUANTITY, CI.CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL(AED.ACTIVE_EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0)) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.STOCK, 0) AS STOCK, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE FROM CART_ITEM CI
INNER JOIN CART C ON C.CART_NO = CI.CART_NO
INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = CI.PRODUCT_NO
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MAX(IMAGE_PATH) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, IMAGE_NO ) AS MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) PI ON PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE C.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CI.CART_ITEM_NO = #{cartItemNo}

SELECT CI.CART_ITEM_NO, CI.CART_NO, CI.PRODUCT_NO, CI.QUANTITY, CI.CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL(AED.ACTIVE_EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0)) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.STOCK, 0) AS STOCK, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE FROM CART_ITEM CI
INNER JOIN CART C ON C.CART_NO = CI.CART_NO
INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = CI.PRODUCT_NO
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
